profile.summary: Love Never Fails is a nonprofit based in Dublin, California, that works to end human trafficking. It provides housing and support for survivors, runs technology job training through its ITbiz Tech Academy, and offers community outreach and prevention education. It has offices across the San Francisco Bay Area and Central Valley.
